parameters.content:
## User-stack variant - OpenShorts clipper integration
Verified from official source (github.com/mutonby/openshorts, 2026-09-23):
  POST {base}/api/process  Authorization: Bearer osk_...  body { url, acknowledged, webhook_url, webhook_secret }  -> returns job_id.
  On completion OpenShorts POSTs the callback: { event:'job.completed', job_id, clips:[{ index, title, video_url, download_url }] } with header X-OpenShorts-Signature: sha256=<hmac-sha256(body, webhook_secret)>.
  CLI equivalents: openshorts process/clips/publish; MCP :8000/mcp.

This workflow WIRES that contract; it does not itself render clips and is NOT runtime-tested (no OpenShorts instance/keys here). It is an integration to configure, not a proven working clipper.

Source correlation: the callback URL carries ?src=<base64(source_url)> so the callback recovers the original source without a datastore. Auth: HMAC verified fail-closed when OPENSHORTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set. Enable the webhook 'Raw Body' option for byte-exact HMAC (set here); if your gateway alters the body, verification will (correctly) fail.

Setup state (PENDING): running OpenShorts (hosted osk_ key OR self-host Docker+FFmpeg on :8000), reachable callback URL, Bearer + webhook_secret bound. No auto-publish.
